description: In inbound.rs decode_msgid_from_url, only six percent-encoded sequences are replaced: %3C, %3c, %3E, %3e, %40, %2F, %20. A message-ID containing other percent-encodable characters (e.g. brackets, plus signs, or characters that percent_encode_msgid does not encode but that survive URL round-tripping via other paths) would be reconstructed incorrectly. The outbound percent_encode_msgid only encodes <, >, @, and space, so the decode covers the encode inverse, but it uses case-sensitive string replacement (checks %3C and %3c separately) and is fragile to any future additions. A proper percent-decode using a standard URL-decode routine would be more robust and maintainable.
title: decode_msgid_from_url: incomplete percent-decode, only handles 6 sequences
